items.difficulty_reason: The lemma states that for a morphism of topoi and a morphism of sheaves into the pullback of a sheaf on the target there is a commutative diagram of localized topoi, with the morphism written as a composite of the localization of the morphism of topoi and a relocalization, and with an explicit description of its pullback (statement lines 7922-7979). The proof is a complete derivation: the commutativity of the first square is obtained by combining the two relevant commutative diagrams (proof lines 7982-7986); the description of the pullback is obtained by combining the two descriptions supplied by the companion results (proof lines 7987-7992); and the last square follows from an identity of fibre products whose verification the author records as formal (proof lines 7993-8002). The non-formal content is the combination of the two descriptions. The claim is H2: a structured derivation with each input named.
